name: Utah Snowball Bash 2025
information:
This competition is organized by the Cubing Club at UVU. Membership is open to both UVU and non-UVU students. For more details, visit the [Cubing Club at UVU tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UtahSnowballBash2025#59029-cubing-club-at-uvu).

Club members will receive a 50% registration discount!

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). 

Go to our [website](utahcubing.org) to find links to our Facebook group , Instagram page, and website, as well as the Rockies Discord Server, to be notified when local competitions are announced and to keep in touch with cubers in the area!
